 UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam Day Guidelines 2026: Reporting Time, Documents, Dress Code
 UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam 2026 will be held on November 19 and 20. Check exam day guidelines, reporting time, admit card, ID proof, dress code, prohibited items, OMR instructions and important examination rules.

 UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam Day Guidelines 2026: Last-Minute Checklist 
 Candidates appearing for the UPESSC Assistant Professor Examination 2026 should carefully follow the examination-day guidelines to avoid last-minute problems at the examination centre. The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) will conduct the written examination on November 19 and 20, 2026, across six divisional headquarters in Uttar Pradesh.
 The examination will be conducted in two shifts on both days. Candidates must carry a printed copy of their admit card and follow the instructions mentioned on their individual hall tickets. They should also check their examination date, shift, reporting time and centre address before leaving home.
 The UPESSC Assistant Professor exam is being conducted under Advertisement No. 04/2026 for recruitment to 1,936 posts. With the examination approaching, candidates should understand the important rules regarding entry, required documents, prohibited items, examination hall behaviour and OMR sheet instructions.
 Here is a detailed guide to the UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam Day Guidelines 2026, including important instructions candidates should know before reaching the examination centre.
 UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam 2026: Important Dates and Timings
 According to the examination schedule announced by the commission on November 6, the written examination will take place on November 19 and 20, 2026.
 The examination will be organised in two shifts at designated centres in six cities: Agra, Meerut, Gorakhpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj and Varanasi.

 Important: The shift allotted to an individual candidate, along with the reporting time and examination centre address, must be checked on their admit card. Do not assume that all candidates appearing on the same date have the same shift.
 UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam Day Guidelines 2026
 Candidates should follow the instructions issued by UPESSC and the examination centre authorities. The following checklist will help candidates prepare for examination day.
 1. Carry a Printed Copy of the Admit Card
 A printed copy of the UPESSC Assistant Professor Admit Card 2026 is essential for entering the examination centre. Candidates should download their hall tickets in advance and take a clear printout.
 Before leaving home, check that:
 Your name is correctly printed.
 Your roll number and registration details are accurate.
 Your photograph and signature are clearly visible.
 Your examination date and shift are correct.
 The examination centre address is readable.
 Candidates should not depend only on a digital copy of the admit card on their mobile phones. Carry a physical printout.
 2. Carry a Valid Original Photo ID Proof
 Candidates should carry an original, valid photo identity document along with their printed admit card. The ID should clearly establish their identity.
 Examples of commonly accepted government-issued photo identity documents include:
 Aadhaar Card
 Voter ID Card
 Passport
 Driving Licence
 Candidates must follow the specific identity-document instructions printed on their admit cards. A photocopy or mobile photograph should not be treated as a substitute for an original ID unless the commission explicitly permits it.
 3. Reach the Examination Centre Before Reporting Time
 Candidates are advised to reach their allotted examination centres well before the reporting time mentioned on their admit cards.
 Avoid reaching the centre at the last minute, as candidates may need time for identity verification, document checking and other entry formalities.
 Plan your journey in advance, particularly if your examination centre is in another city. Candidates travelling to Agra, Meerut, Gorakhpur, Lucknow, Prayagraj or Varanasi should check the route and available transport facilities beforehand.
 4. Follow the Instructions Printed on the Admit Card
 The UPESSC Assistant Professor admit card contains important examination-related information. Candidates should read every instruction carefully before appearing for the examination.
 Pay particular attention to:
 Reporting time.
 Examination date and shift.
 Examination centre location.
 Required documents.
 Permitted stationery.
 Entry and examination hall instructions.
 In case of any difference between general information available online and the instructions printed on the official admit card, candidates should follow the latest instructions issued by UPESSC.
 5. Avoid Carrying Prohibited Electronic Devices
 Candidates should avoid carrying electronic gadgets and unauthorised materials into the examination premises.
 Items such as mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, earphones, calculators and other communication equipment should not be taken into the examination hall unless expressly permitted by the commission.
 Candidates should also avoid carrying written notes, books, loose papers or other unauthorised study materials.
 The safest approach is to leave unnecessary belongings at home rather than risk an entry problem at the centre.
 6. Use Only a Black Ballpoint Pen for the OMR Sheet
 This is one of the most important UPESSC Assistant Professor examination instructions.
 According to the recruitment notification, candidates must use a black ballpoint pen to fill the rectangular boxes and answer bubbles on the OMR sheet.
 The following stationery items are prohibited for filling the OMR sheet:
 Blue, red or any other coloured ballpoint pens.
 Gel pens.
 Fountain pens.
 Sketch pens.
 HB pencils.
 Whitener.
 Candidates should carry a working black ballpoint pen and preferably keep an additional one, subject to the centre's permitted-item instructions.
 Dips Academy
 7. Do Not Make Corrections on the OMR Answer Sheet
 Candidates must be extremely careful while marking answers on the OMR sheet.
 As per the official examination instructions:
 Fill the correct answer bubble completely.
 Do not mark more than one bubble for a question.
 Do not use an eraser, blade, fingernail or whitener to modify an answer.
 Do not make unnecessary dots, marks or symbols on the OMR sheet.
 Fill in personal details accurately.
 Once a bubble has been filled, changing the answer is not permitted. Marking multiple options or damaging the OMR sheet may result in the answer sheet not being evaluated.
 The commission has specifically warned that improperly completed OMR sheets may not be evaluated.
 Dips Academy
 8. Maintain Discipline Inside the Examination Hall
 Candidates must maintain proper discipline throughout the UPESSC Assistant Professor written examination.
 The commission has stated that malpractice, cheating, indiscipline, misbehaviour and other undesirable activities may lead to cancellation of candidature.
 Candidates should therefore:
 Follow the instructions of the invigilators.
 Avoid communicating with other candidates during the examination.
 Do not exchange stationery or other materials without permission.
 Do not attempt to copy answers or use unfair means.
 Avoid arguments or disruptive behaviour inside the examination hall.
 Violation of examination rules may also lead to debarment from future examinations conducted by the commission.
 Dips Academy
 9. Follow the Examination Centre Allotment
 Candidates must appear at the examination centre allotted to them by UPESSC.
 The commission's recruitment instructions clarify that candidates are required to take the examination only at their allotted centre. Requests for changing the examination centre are not permitted.
 Candidates should not confuse the advance examination district information with the final admit card. The district intimation is provided to help candidates plan their travel, while the admit card contains the official examination details required for entry.
 PN 06-11-2026
 +1
 10. PwD Candidates and Scribe Facility
 Candidates with benchmark disabilities who are eligible for a scribe facility should ensure that they have completed the required formalities.
 According to the UPESSC recruitment notification:
 Eligible candidates must arrange their own scribe.
 Details of the scribe must be registered with the commission at least one week before the written examination.
 The scribe facility is subject to the applicable government orders.
 Eligible candidates are entitled to 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour.
 Candidates using a scribe should ensure that all registration and documentation requirements have been completed. They should also follow any additional instructions issued by the commission regarding the examination centre.

 What Should Candidates Do If They Find an Error on Their Admit Card?
 Candidates should carefully verify their admit cards immediately after downloading them.
 If there is an error in the candidate's name, photograph, signature, roll number or other examination-related information, they should contact UPESSC through its official communication channels as soon as possible.
 Do not wait until reaching the examination centre to report an error. Keep a copy of the admit card and relevant application details available when contacting the commission.
 Official website: https://upessc.up.gov.in/

 When will the UPESSC Assistant Professor Exam 2026 be conducted?
